title: Tractable Estimation of the Money Pump Index: A Comment
abstract: arXiv:2609.16086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Money Pump Index (MPI) of Echenique et al. (2011) measures the severity of consumer irrationality, but computing the exact mean and median MPI over all revealed preference cycles is NP-hard (Smeulders et al., 2013). Existing solutions rely on heuristic proxies, such as evaluating only shorter cycles or bounding the MPI. By framing revealed preferences as a directed graph, this paper projects choice violations onto fundamental cycle bases, which are minimal sets of linearly independent cycles that span the graph's entire cycle space. This yields computationally tractable estimators for the mean and median MPI that are asymptotically equivalent to the original MPI. Applying this methodology to the scanner dataset analyzed by Echenique et al. (2011) and Smeulders et al., (2013), the proposed estimators compute quickly and with negligible small-sample bias.

translated_title: 货币泵指数的可计算估计：一则评论
translated_abstract: Echenique等人（2011）提出的货币泵指数（MPI）衡量了消费者非理性的严重程度，但在所有显示偏好循环上计算精确的平均值和中位数MPI是NP难问题（Smeulders等人，2013）。现有的解决方案依赖于启发式替代方法，例如仅评估较短的循环或对MPI设定上下界。本文通过将显示偏好构建为有向图，将选择行为违背投影到基本循环基上——即张成图整个循环空间的线性无关循环的最小集合。由此得到了与原始MPI渐近等价的平均值和中位数MPI的可计算估计量。将该方法应用于Echenique等人（2011）和Smeulders等人（2013）所分析的扫描仪数据集，结果表明所提出的估计量计算速度快且小样本偏差可忽略不计。
tldr: 本文通过将选择违背投影到显示偏好有向图的基本循环基上，提出了与原始货币泵指数渐近等价且计算高效、小样本偏差可忽略的平均和中位数MPI估计量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes computationally tractable estimators for the mean and median Money Pump Index that are asymptotically equivalent to the original MPI by projecting choice violations onto fundamental cycle bases of the revealed preference directed graph.
